name: ~inducksql
description: Exports the coa schema to a read-only SQLite file for @sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm

scripts.build: bun build --target bun ./index.ts --outfile bundle.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n vite,vue-tsc,sqlite-serve "vite --config web/vite.config.ts --port 8009" "vue-tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json --watch" "bun run ./vfs/range-server.ts coa.sqlite 8901"
scripts.prod:build-docker: REPO_NAME=ghcr.io/bperel/inducksql pnpm -F '~ci' prod:build-docker -f apps/inducksql/Dockerfile && REPO_NAME=ghcr.io/bperel/inducksql-exporter pnpm -F '~ci' prod:build-docker -f apps/inducksql/Dockerfile-exporter
